$comment: ★ DELIBERATELY CONTENT-FREE — DO NOT 'FIX' THIS BY PADDING IT OUT. Neutral shipped <TargetConditionals.h> (Darwin/Apple), added by the SQLite-CLI-for-arm64-Darwin cycle. THE HEADER EXISTS SO THAT AN #include OF IT RESOLVES; it deliberately publishes no TARGET_OS_* / TARGET_CPU_* / TARGET_RT_* value. WHY, stated so a later reader does not mistake this for an oversight: (1) ★ THE CORPUS USAGE, RE-MEASURED THIS CYCLE RATHER THAN INHERITED — the hand-off note for this work said 'the only 3 references are sqlite3.c:40630-40632' and, separately, 'TARGET_OS_*: zero hits in the corpus'. BOTH ARE WRONG AS STATED, and the corrected numbers are recorded here so the next reader does not re-derive them from the same bad source. A grep over the whole staged tree ($HOME/src/sqlite) finds EIGHT hits naming THREE distinct macros — `TARGET_OS_EMBEDDED`, `TARGET_IPHONE_SIMULATOR`, `TARGET_OS_MACCATALYST` — at `src/os_unix.c:125-127`, `bld-dss/tsrc/os_unix.c:125-127`, `bld-dss/sqlite3.c:40630-40632` and `bld-dss/tclsqlite3.c:40631-40633` (the last three are the same source amalgamated). ★ THE CONCLUSION SURVIVES THE CORRECTION, which is why this file is still content-free: every one of the eight is of the `!defined(X) || X == 0` shape — a form SATISFIED by the macro being undefined, so publishing a value could only change behaviour, never enable it — and all eight sit inside ONE `HAVE_GETHOSTUUID` block whose outer guard tests `__MAC_OS_X_VERSION_MIN_REQUIRED` / `__IPHONE_OS_VERSION_MIN_REQUIRED`, neither of which sqlite ever defines, so the block is dead on our target regardless. (2) WE CANNOT MEASURE THE REAL VALUES HERE. The SDK slice this cycle worked from (/tmp/apple_sdk_probe/MacOSX26.4.sdk/usr/include) carries only sys/{fcntl,file,mount,param,syslimits}.h + malloc/malloc.h — TargetConditionals.h is NOT in it. Apple's family is also subtler than it looks (TARGET_OS_MAC is 1 on EVERY Apple platform, not just macOS; TARGET_OS_OSX is the macOS-only bit), and a descriptor SHADOWS the real header TOTALLY (include_path_resolve.hpp:60-75, Descriptor → Source → NotFound), so a guessed value would silently steer a real consumer's #if down the wrong arm on a NATIVE macOS host too, where the SDK header is what is used today via D-INCLUDE-ANGLE-SOURCE-FALLBACK. A partial-but-correct surface is a fail-loud gap; a complete-but-guessed surface is a silent miscompile. We take the gap, and we ANCHOR it: D-FFI-DARWIN-TARGETCONDITIONALS-EMPTY. ★ WHY THERE IS A MACRO HERE AT ALL: the loader REFUSES a descriptor that declares nothing (shipped_lib_descriptor.cpp:2188-2199 — 'declares nothing — needs at least one of symbols, constants, floatConstants, typedefs, structs, unions, or macros'), so a literally empty file cannot ship. The include guard is the one declaration the real header unambiguously makes, and publishing it costs nothing: no consumer branches on it. `__TARGETCONDITIONALS__` is the DOCUMENTED Apple guard name — NOT measured here (see (2)); every sibling Darwin header in the measured slice follows the `_SYS_<NAME>_H_` / `_MALLOC_MALLOC_H_` convention, and this one is the family's known exception. ★ NO `symbols` AND NO `library` KEY, BY DESIGN: DSS EAGER-IMPORTS every function a descriptor lists, so an unexported name breaks EVERY binary's LOAD (D-FFI-DESCRIPTOR-EAGER-IMPORT, macho exit 127). This header declares no functions in C either, so the blast radius of including it is exactly nil. Gated availableObjectFormats:[macho] — an elf/pe #include fails loud (the windows.json:5 [pe] precedent, inverted).
